title: Privacy & data (M13)
brief: Privacy & data screen of goop (/privacy, from Settings). goop is local-only: encrypted SQLite (key sealed by TPM2 on Linux, DPAPI on Windows), no telemetry, secrets removed before any model sees text (DLP), integrity check on the database at start. Full screen with title breadcrumb (Settings › Privacy & data · goop.db on this machine · esc back to settings) and no key-hint line under the header. A calm trust summary line (green ● all local · encrypted · no telemetry · 0 personal data sent). Two panes like M8: on the left What goop keeps, one line per store with count, size and age, your data apart from Not personal data (Offers 412 · 18 MB · kept 90 days; Sessions 7 · 2.1 MB · until you clear; Rules 7 · 4 KB; Profile and CV cv-2026.pdf · 310 KB · read Oct 28; Search index 9 MB · rebuilt daily; Logs no text · 1.2 MB · kept 14 days; Models 5 roles · 31 GB · /models), each personal store clearable on its own, Sessions selected with x clear; on the right the selection's details and what clearing removes and keeps, the protection facts (Encryption AES-256 SQLite3MultipleCiphers with the key sealed by TPM2, Integrity checked at start ok 09:00, Network only public job boards and model downloads, Secrets removed before a model sees text · 3 this month) and retention form rows (offers 90 days, logs 14 days). One status line with the privacy focus mode, ↑↓ move · x clear this · e export (encrypted .zip) · r retention · D delete all data · esc back, and ? help on the right; D and clearing a store both use M11 type-to-confirm. Below the screen: the export toast, the clear-sessions ask (Clear 7 sessions · 2.1 MB? type clear to confirm · esc cancel) and the pink integrity-failed status line chip.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Trust summary plus a store list grouped as your data vs models and one details pane with protection facts and retention rows; every store, its size and what protects it are visible at once, but the details show one store at a time, the facts are static text that may be skimmed, and the screen hides the chat
